prompt:
Convert this Markdown table with merged-looking header groups into a properly normalized JSON array, correctly attributing each sub-column to its parent header:
| Name | Q1 | | Q2 | |
|------|-----|-----|-----|-----|
| | Sales | Cost | Sales | Cost |
| Alice | 100 | 40 | 120 | 45 |

criterion_scores.name: Relational Integrity Score
criterion_scores.justification: The nested JSON structure correctly preserves the hierarchical relationship between the quarter headers (Q1, Q2) and their respective sub-columns (Sales, Cost).

criterion_scores.name: Edge Case Handling Score
criterion_scores.justification: The model successfully parsed the complex, merged header structure of the markdown table without losing any structural relationships or causing data errors.

criterion_scores.name: Output Validity Score
criterion_scores.justification: The output is syntactically valid JSON, properly formatted and matching the expected target format.

criterion_scores.name: Completeness Score
criterion_scores.justification: All data points from the source table, including the name 'Alice' and all numerical values, are fully represented in the output without any omissions.
